notes.title: June 30 Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in EN/JP Builds

 Corrected formatting issues with the Epilogue Results Screen.
 Corrected various lines of dialog involving font color changes.

notes.title: March 10th Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in EN Build

 Fixed a display issue where some color tags would show in one scene.

notes.title: Feb 9th Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in EN/JP Builds

 Corrected text alignment in logs and help menus.
 Various controller and keyboard glyph corrections.
 While Windows 7 is not an officially supported platform (see Minimum Requirements on the Store Page), we fixed an issue where end of credits would freeze for Windows 7 users. In essence, Windows 7 can't handle h264 encoding, so the solution was to use vp8 encoding.

Changes in EN Build

 Quest Logs now detail full history of quest.



We hope our Windows 7 users are able to enjoy the game without further issue.

notes.title: Jan 21st Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in EN/JP Builds

 D-Pad and Arrow Keys now honor Retreat or Turn Around gameplay options
 Controller will now bootstrap if the connection is lost or a controller is plugged in during gameplay.
 Framerate is now correctly tied to refresh rate. (yea, you can play at 144hz now!) ːsteamhappyː
 Various texture fixes

  Glitch on edge of menu items removed
  The white cross on the box in the Storage Tent



Changes in EN Build

 Quest Clear and Treasure Ranking images translated

notes.title: Dec 24th Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in EN/JP Builds

Steam Cloud should now function.
Instructions for text input are now more readable
 

Changes in EN Build

 A Weapon's Attribute is now properly aligned in its description window
 A Supply's Attribute is now properly aligned in its description window
 "Quality Spear" no longer shows as "Average Spear"
 

Changes in JP Build

 Radio subtitles in the Rec Tent are now in Japanese
 Gameplay controls for controller and keyboard are now fully visible

notes.title: Nov 18th Patch
notes.notes:
EN/JP build changes

 Events and animations will now play without delay (regardless of region format). This issue was making the game slower for customers mainly in Brazil. 


Thanks to everyone who reported this issue in this thread
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1570510/discussions/1/3158706376172943629/

notes.title: Nov 10 Patch
notes.notes:
Changes in EN/JP Builds

Removed excessive logging
Searching properly animates ellipsis
Instructions in the options menu now reflect Keyboard controls


Changes in JP Builds

Soft lock when encountering the Ice Mandrill has been fixed
All templates in character creation now have proper entries
The alignment of UI in the character details menu has been fixed
